node.statement: Nodes 1.1-1.7 establish the root with the universal witnesses C_grp=600, C_pol=P, kappa_pol=min(q,1/64): node 1.5 gives global C^1 maps, basepoints, and the two 84*epsilon_r closeness bounds; node 1.6 gives the 520*epsilon_r associativity defect; node 1.7 gives inverse defects 260*epsilon_r and 280*epsilon_r. Every numerical coefficient is at most C_grp, so all estimates required by node 1 hold with C_grp=600.
